title: Career Roadmap: Cooperative Officer
summary: Career Domain: Agriculture, Food & Life Sciences · Qualification Pathway: BBA / BMS / BBM – BBA - Cooperative / Agri / Rural Management · Target Career: Cooperative Officer

facts.Current degree: BBA / BMS / BBM (Bachelor of Business Administration / Management Studies)

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

blocks.text: A Cooperative Officer helps run and supervise cooperative societies - dairy, credit, marketing or housing - that are owned by their members. They work for state cooperative departments, cooperative banks or federations.

items.text: Register, inspect and audit cooperative societies
Guide societies on rules, elections and accounts
Support members' training and business plans
Dairy and marketing federations (e.g. Amul-type unions)
Learn accounting, economics and rural sociology
Visit a dairy or credit cooperative
Study cooperative law and your state's Cooperative Societies Act
Follow the Ministry of Cooperation's schemes
Intern with a cooperative bank or federation
Do a project on one society's working
Prepare for state PSC cooperative posts
Courses at VAMNICOM Pune or state cooperative training institutes

blocks.label: Before you enrol
blocks.text: Check the current syllabus, fees and eligibility on the certifying body's official website.
